item.title: California lawmakers weigh reforms to child abuse law amid costly litigation
item.description: In what’s likely to be one of the most contentious issues facing the California Legislature in 2026, lawmakers are again debating whether to reform a 2020 law that lifted the statute of limitations on childhood sexual abuse lawsuits. That law, Assembly Bill 218, sparked a blitz of costly litigation against schools and other public agencies. The post California lawmakers weigh reforms to child abuse law amid costly litigation appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.
